Shravana Banthu
Shravana Banthu is a 1984 Kannada romantic melodrama film, written and directed by Singeetham Srinivasa Rao. The film features Rajkumar, Urvashi and Srinath playing the pivotal roles. The film, produced by P. A. Kameshwara Rao, deals with reincarnation as the subject where the lead roles get killed for their romance and then they are shown to be reborn again and fall in love yet again. The dialogues and lyrics were written by Chi. Udaya Shankar. The film was received exceptionally well at the box-office and was one of the biggest hits of 1984. This was also the first Kannada movie to show a computer on- screen.
